d: A strange outbreak could hit workplaces around the world on November 19. It's being called the "GTA Flu", and it has nothing to do with a virus. After 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI is finally arriving, and the excitement is already making waves. From companies offering employees time off to play, to an Indian firm declaring a holiday and a US Army unit offering soldiers a four-day pass, the GTA fever is spreading. Some estimates suggest the game could sell 40 million copies in its first three months and generate over $3 billion. Is GTA VI powerful enough to bring workplaces to a standstill?
